banks.name: Symphony orchestra
banks.description: Woodwinds, brass, timpani and strings sampled from VSCO 2 Community Edition, plus two synths. Built in: always loaded.

banks.name: Jazz combo
banks.description: Piano, vibes, tenor sax, upright bass and a drum kit; plus the orchestral trumpets and trombones.

banks.name: Folk group
banks.description: Fiddle, folk harp, recorder, harmonica, frame drum and hand percussion; plus flute, clarinet, cellos and basses.

banks.name: Electronica
banks.description: FM piano and clavisynth from a TX81Z, a synthesized drum machine, and lead, pad and pluck synth patches; plus the synth bass and arp.
